posts.text: 🚨 LeToya Luckett says her manager claimed her music was blackballed from radio after LeToya left Destiny’s Child, alleging stations were warned they could lose access to the group’s records if they played hers. LeToya also shared that her team shielded her from much of what was happening behind the scenes. Tap in with @LorenLoRosa for all the details.
